exercises.instructionEn: Complete the dialogue below using will or won't, then listen and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi dialogni will yoki won't bilan to'ldiring, so'ng tinglab javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ONA ESLATADI - FARZAND TINChLANTIRADI.


TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  A: Remember, it's chilly where
     you're going, so pack some warm
     clothes.
  J: I know, Mum, I 1) WILL.
  A: And the roads might be icy, so
     please don't drive too fast.
  J: Don't worry, Mum, I 2) WON'T.
  A: Don't forget to lock everything
     before you leave.
  J: I 3) WON'T.
  A: Do you promise to call me when
     you get there?
  J: Yes, Mum, I 4) WILL, I promise,
     but stop worrying! I'm going to
     have a great time!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QOIDA - JUDA MUHIM              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Ona TASDIQ gap aytsa
  ('pack some clothes',
   'do you promise?')
     → 'I WILL' (qilaman)

  Ona INKOR gap aytsa
  ("don't drive", "don't forget")
     → "I WON'T" (qilmayman)

  ⚠ Javob onaning gapiga QARAB
  o'zgaradi!


⚠ 3-BANDGA DIQQAT:

  A: "DON'T FORGET to lock ..."
  J: "I WON'T." = unutmayman

  ⚠ 'I will' bo'lsa 'unutaman' degan
  ma'no chiqardi - NOTO'G'RI!


⚠ 'CHILLY':

  = salqin, sovuqroq.
  ⚠ 'cold' dan yengilroq.


⚠ 'ICY':

  = muzli.
  ⚠ 'ice' + '-y' ('e' TUShADI).


⚠ 'MIGHT':

  'the roads MIGHT be icy'
  = yo'llar muzli BO'LIShI MUMKIN.
  ⚠ 'may' bilan bir xil, lekin
  ehtimoli kamroq.


⚠ 'TO PACK':

  = joylamoq (chamadonga).
  ⚠ 'to unpack' = bo'shatmoq.


⚠ 'TO LOCK':

  = qulflamoq.
  ⚠ 'to unlock' = qulfni ochmoq.


⚠ 'TO PROMISE':

  = va'da bermoq.
  ⚠ 'I promise' - juda ko'p
  ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'STOP WORRYING!':

  ⚠ 'stop' dan keyin -ING.
  ⚠ 'stop to worry' BOShQA ma'no:
  'xavotir olish uchun to'xtamoq'.

exercises.explanationUz:
'LL QISQARTMASINING TALAFFUZI.


⚠ 'LL JUDA QISQA O'QILADI:

  I'll    /aɪl/    - 'ayl'
  She'll  /ʃiːl/   - 'shiil'
  He'll   /hiːl/   - 'hiil'
  We'll   /wiːl/   - 'wiil'
  You'll  /juːl/   - 'yuul'
  They'll /ðeɪl/   - 'zeyl'

  ⚠ 'will' so'zi TO'LIQ eshitilmaydi -
  faqat /l/ tovushi qo'shiladi.


⚠ ADAShTIRISh XAVFI:

  'He'll' /hiːl/ va 'heal' /hiːl/ -
     BIR XIL eshitiladi!
  'We'll' /wiːl/ va 'wheel' /wiːl/ -
     BIR XIL!
  'I'll' /aɪl/ va 'aisle'/'isle' -
     BIR XIL!

  ⚠ Faqat KONTEKSTdan tushuniladi.


⚠ 'DARK L':

  So'z OXIRIDAGI 'l' ingliz tilida
  QALINROQ aytiladi (dark l).
  ⚠ Til uchi tishga tegadi, orqasi
  ko'tariladi.


OLTI GAP:

  1 I'll see you then.
    /aɪl siː juː ðen/
  2 She'll be back soon.
    /ʃiːl biː bæk suːn/
  3 He'll meet us outside the shop.
    /hiːl miːt ʌs aʊtˈsaɪd ðə ʃɒp/
  4 We'll tell them tomorrow.
    /wiːl tel ðəm təˈmɒrəʊ/
  5 You'll cut your finger.
    /juːl kʌt jɔː ˈfɪŋɡə/
  6 They'll lose their way.
    /ðeɪl luːz ðeə weɪ/


⚠ 'TO LOSE ONE'S WAY':

  = adashmoq.
  ⚠ 'lose' /luːz/ - 'z' bilan.
  ⚠ 'loose' /luːs/ (bo'sh) bilan
  ADAShTIRMANG!


⚠ 'THEIR' va 'THERE':

  Ikkalasi BIR XIL o'qiladi /ðeə/.
  ⚠ their = ularning
  ⚠ there = u yerda

sentences.hintUz:
⚠ "I'll" /aɪl/ - bir bo'g'in.
⚠ 'aisle' (yo'lak) bilan BIR XIL eshitiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: When we write a formal letter asking for information we can divide it into three paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Ma'lumot so'rab rasmiy xat yozganda uni uch xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMIY XAT YoZISh QOIDASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  UCh XATBOShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  BOShLANIShI: 'Dear Sir/Madam,'

  1-XATBOShI: YoZISh SABABI
     'I am writing regarding your
      advertisement ...'

  2-XATBOShI: SAVOLLAR
     'Will ...? Could you tell me
      ...?'

  3-XATBOShI: YaKUNIY SO'ZLAR
     'I look forward to hearing from
      you.'

  TUGAShI: 'Yours faithfully,'
     + TO'LIQ ISM


⚠ 'DEAR SIR/MADAM' → 'YOURS
   FAITHFULLY':

  ⚠ Bu JUFTLIK - har doim birga.
  ⚠ Ism ma'lum bo'lsa:
     'Dear Mr Smith' →
     'Yours sincerely'.


⚠ TO'LIQ ISM ShART:

  ⚠ Rasmiy xatda faqat ism emas,
  ISM VA FAMILIYa yoziladi:
  'Darren Barnet' (37-betdagi xat).


⚠ RASMIY XAT BELGILARI:

  • QISQARTMA YO'Q ('I am', "I'm"
    emas)
  • rasmiy so'zlar: regarding,
    states, mentions, In addition,
    Finally
  • muloyim qoliplar: 'I would be
    grateful if you could ...'
  • so'zlashuv iboralari YO'Q

points.en: When we write a formal letter asking for information we can divide it into three paragraphs.
points.uz: Ma'lumot so'rab rasmiy xat yozganda uni uch xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.

points.en: We start the letter with Dear Sir/Madam.
In the first paragraph, we mention the reason why we are writing the letter.
points.uz: Birinchi xatboshida xatni yozish sababini eslatib o'tamiz.

points.en: In the second paragraph, we ask questions about the information we need.
points.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida bizga kerak ma'lumot haqida savollar beramiz.

points.en: In the last paragraph, we usually say we hope to hear from the person soon.
points.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida odatda tez orada javob kutayotganimizni aytamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'I look forward to HEARING from you.' -
'to' dan keyin -ING.

points.en: We end our letter with Yours faithfully, and our full name.
points.uz: Xatni 'Yours faithfully' va to'liq ismimiz bilan tugatamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Dear Sir/Madam' → 'Yours FAITHFULLY'.
⚠ TO'LIQ ism (ism + familiya) shart.

exercises.explanationUz:
RAFTING E'LONI - TO'LIQ MATNI.


⚠ 'WHITEWATER RAFTING':

  = tez oqar daryoda qayiqda sayr.
  ⚠ 'whitewater' = ko'pikli, tez
  oqar suv.


⚠ 'THE COLORADO RIVER':

  AQShdagi mashhur daryo, Buyuk
  Kanyon orqali oqadi.
  ⚠ Daryo nomlari oldidan 'THE'
  ShART.


⚠ '$259':

  = 'two hundred and fifty-nine
  dollars'.
  ⚠ '$' SONDAN OLDIN yoziladi.


⚠ 'A 4-DAY TRIP':

  ⚠ 'day' BIRLIKDA (defisli sifat).


⚠ 'EQUIPMENT':

  = jihoz, anjom.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN!
  ⚠ 'equipments' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'a piece of equipment' ✓


⚠ 'TRANSPORTATION':

  ⚠ AQShda 'transportation',
  Britaniyada 'transport'.


⚠ 'DENVER, COLORADO':

  Denver - Kolorado shtatining
  poytaxti.
  ⚠ AQShda shahar va shtat
  VERGUL bilan yoziladi.


TO'RT QAYD (savolga aylantirasiz):

  waterproof clothing?
     → suv o'tkazmaydigan kiyim
  sleeping bags?
     → uxlash qoplari
  How many per group?
     → guruhda nechta gid?
  journey - how long?
     → yo'l qancha davom etadi?


⚠ 'WATERPROOF':

  = suv o'tkazmaydigan.
  ⚠ 'water' + 'proof'.
  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'fireproof',
  'soundproof', 'bulletproof'.


⚠ 'CLOTHING':

  = kiyim-kechak (umumiy).
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'clothes' - HAR DOIM ko'plikda.


⚠ 'PER':

  = har biriga.
  ⚠ 'per group' = har guruhga,
  'per person' = har kishiga.

exercises.explanationUz:
REJA (daftardagi):

  Dear Sir/Madam,
  Para 1: explain why you are writing
  Para 2: ask your questions
  Para 3: closing remarks
  Yours faithfully,
  (your full name)


⚠ 120-180 SO'Z:

  ⚠ Kamida 120, ko'pi 180.
  ⚠ Uch xatboshi - har biri
  taxminan 40-60 so'z.


⚠ 37-BETDAGI XAT NAMUNA:

  Darren Barnet ning Shri-Lanka
  haqidagi xati AYNI ShU tuzilishda.


⚠ TO'RT SAVOL (qaydlardan):

  1 Will waterproof clothing be
    included?
  2 Will sleeping bags be provided?
  3 How many guides will there be
    per group?
  4 How long will the journey take?


⚠ 'HOW LONG WILL ... TAKE?':

  = qancha vaqt oladi?
  ⚠ 'to take' bu yerda = vaqt olmoq.
  ⚠ 'How long will the journey be?'
  ham mumkin.


⚠ 'TO PROVIDE':

  = ta'minlamoq, bermoq.
  ⚠ 'Will sleeping bags be provided?'
  - MAJHUL nisbat.


⚠ 'A JOURNEY':

  = safar, yo'l.
  ⚠ 'a trip' - qisqaroq sayohat.
  ⚠ 'a travel' - XATO! 'travel'
  fe'l yoki sanalmaydigan ot.

structure.exampleEn: I am writing regarding your advertisement for a four-day whitewater rafting trip on the Colorado River. I am very interested in joining this trip and would be grateful if you could answer a few questions.

structure.hintUz: waterproof clothing? sleeping bags? guides per group? journey - how long?
structure.exampleEn: Your advertisement states that the price includes rafting equipment. Will waterproof clothing be provided as well? The advertisement also mentions food and camping equipment. Will sleeping bags be included? In addition, regarding the professional guides, how many will there be per group? Finally, transportation to and from the river is included, but how long will the journey from Denver take?
Thank you for your help. I look forward to hearing from you.

modelAnswers: I am writing regarding your advertisement for a four-day whitewater rafting trip on the Colorado River. I am very interested in joining this trip and would be grateful if you could answer a few questions.

Your advertisement states that the price includes rafting equipment. Will waterproof clothing be provided as well? The advertisement also mentions food and camping equipment. Will sleeping bags be included? In addition, regarding the professional guides, how many will there be per group? Finally, transportation to and from the river is included, but how long will the journey from Denver take?
Thank you for your help. I look forward to hearing from you.
modelAnswersUz: Kolorado daryosidagi to'rt kunlik rafting sayohati haqidagi e'loningiz yuzasidan yozyapman. Bu sayohatga qo'shilishga juda qiziqaman va bir necha savolga javob bersangiz, minnatdor bo'lardim.

E'loningizda narxga rafting jihozlari kirishi aytilgan. Suv o'tkazmaydigan kiyim ham beriladimi? E'londa oziq-ovqat va lager jihozlari ham eslatib o'tilgan. Uxlash qoplari kiradimi? Bundan tashqari, professional gidlarga kelsak, har guruhga nechta gid bo'ladi? Nihoyat, daryoga borish va qaytish transporti kiradi, lekin Denverdan yo'l qancha davom etadi?
Yordamingiz uchun rahmat. Sizdan xabar kutaman.

TO'RT MAQOL - HAMMASI VAQT VA
REJA HAQIDA.

  ⚠ 5-unit mavzusi 'Planning Ahead'

  sababli maqollar ham vaqt haqida.


⚠ 'SECOND THOUGHTS':

⚠ 'TIME FLIES':

  = suv qalqishi (dengizda).
  ⚠ 'high tide' = suv ko'tarilishi,
  'low tide' = suv qaytishi.


⚠ 'WAIT FOR NO MAN':

  ⚠ Eski ingliz tili tuzilishi.
  ⚠ Hozirgi tilda: 'don't wait for
  anyone'.
  ⚠ 'to wait FOR' - 'for' predlogi
  ShART.

items.answerEn: It means that if you think about something again, you often make a better decision.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni biror narsa haqida qayta o'ylasang, ko'pincha yaxshiroq qaror qabul qilasan. (O'zbekchada: 'Yetti o'lchab, bir kes'.)

items.answerEn: It means that even if today was bad, you can start again tomorrow. Don't lose hope.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni bugun yomon o'tgan bo'lsa ham, ertaga qaytadan boshlash mumkin. Umidni yo'qotma.

items.en: Time flies when you're having fun.
items.answerEn: It means that when you enjoy yourself, time seems to pass very quickly.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni zavqlanib turganingda vaqt juda tez o'tayotgandek tuyuladi.

items.en: Time and tide wait for no man.
items.uz: Vaqt va suv qalqishi hech kimni kutmaydi.
items.answerEn: It means that time doesn't stop for anyone, so you should not waste it.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni vaqt hech kim uchun to'xtamaydi, shuning uchun uni behuda sarflamaslik kerak. (O'zbekchada: 'Vaqt - oltin'.)

patterns.exampleEn: Pack some warm clothes. - I know, Mum, I will.
patterns.exampleUz: Issiq kiyim ol. - Bilaman, oyi, olaman.

patterns.exampleEn: Don't forget to lock everything. - I won't.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ INKOR buyruqqa → "I WON'T".
⚠ 'I will' bo'lsa TESKARI ma'no chiqadi!

patterns.formula: I am writing regarding your advertisement for [nima].
patterns.exampleEn: I am writing regarding your advertisement for a four-day rafting trip.
patterns.exampleUz: To'rt kunlik rafting sayohati haqidagi e'loningiz yuzasidan yozyapman.

patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ MAJHUL nisbat - rasmiy uslubda ko'p.
⚠ 'will be' + 3-shakl.

patterns.exampleEn: How long will the journey from Denver take?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to take' bu yerda = vaqt olmoq.
⚠ 'take' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

⚠ 'Dear Sir/Madam' bilan JUFT.
⚠ TO'LIQ ism (ism + familiya) shart.
